verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents a single account API key copied from the Integrations page and used as a bearer token, plus an OAuth connection for ChatGPT. Nothing in the evidence describes issuing scoped, read-only, or least-privilege credentials for an agent. The Super Admin mode, which bypasses team privacy settings to query all data, broadens access rather than limiting it, so it does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
